title: Polpette alla Napoletana
subtitle: Neapolitan Meatballs

items: An equal amount or a little more parsley, chopped or torn
75% of a fist-sized chunk of Italian bread (80 g), crust removed
5 large heaping spoons freshly grated Parmigiano cheese (240 ml)
1 tsp salt and 20 grinds pepper, to taste
3–5 swirls extra-virgin olive oil in the bottom of the pot (½ cup? 120 ml)

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine ground pork and beef, raisins, pine nuts, parsley, basil, Parmigiano, salt and pepper. The source also lists ground veal but does not specify when to add it; see review note.
Soak bread in a cup of milk; squeeze out excess milk. Break bread into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Add egg and mix until evenly distributed. Shape into golf-ball-sized meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and cook the onion until translucent. Add red wine and tomato purée and bring to a boil.
Add the uncooked meatballs and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes.
reviewFlags: The source lists ground veal but omits it from the mixing directions. Confirm whether to add it; the olive oil amount is marked uncertain in the source.
